				limit = { is_ruler = yes }
				create_maa_regiment = {
					type = huscarl
					size = 5
				}
				add_contact = character:364
				if = {
					limit = { character:364 ?= { is_alive = yes } }
					add_opinion = {
						target = character:364

					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { character:364 ?= { is_alive = yes } }

						target = character:364

						opinion = 50
					}
